points.name: PLAN-004 point 1: forty due visits retain the exact remainder after thirty bookings, eight emailed offers, two declines and Worker restart
PLAN-004 point 2: every due entry retains its agreement, ordinal, clamped calendar date, customer, site, ZIP, job and booking state
PLAN-004 point 3: local today differs from UTC and date bounds and ZIP filters are exact and inclusive
PLAN-004 point 4: completing the later entitlement first removes only that visit and attributes the worker completion
PLAN-004 point 5: booking, cancellation, actual term expiry and agreement end retain outstanding work
PLAN-004 point 6: a Worker upgrade maps older stored jobs to first unclaimed ordinals while new jobs keep their chosen ordinal
PLAN-004 point 7: a cancelled job is rebooked without duplication and due reads enforce desk branch authority without writes
